spoken: This regression models sales from ad spend, store size, and region. The seeded case study has one hundred twenty stores. R-squared is sixty-five point six three percent, and the F test is below zero point zero zero zero one.
Technical adds the standard error, the t statistic, and the ninety-five percent interval. Ad spend reads one point seven six, with an interval from one point five one to two point zero one.
Raising ad spend to the top of its slider moves predicted sales from one hundred sixteen point three seven to one hundred sixty-nine point six seven.
These residual plots use this fit. Residuals against fitted values show what the line leaves behind. The normal Q-Q plot compares that shape with a straight line.
Cook's distance, as this screen calculates it, stays under the zero point five line. Three rows are flagged by standardized residuals above two.

Refitting without those flagged rows changes the fit. R-squared moves from zero point six five six three to zero point six nine three zero, and the sample falls from one hundred twenty to one hundred seventeen.
See the fit. Read the uncertainty.
